name: Lost Found Secure
summary:
The world has begun to distort — reality bending in ways no one can explain. Unseen forces twist ordinary spaces, and objects once harmless now conceal something wrong.

You are a new field assistant assigned to Oracle, the Field Containment Operative with the ability to sense anomalies hidden within things.

Your task: enter reported sites of abnormal activity, investigate the place, and secure the source before it spreads.

What you hear and see inside these places... is not imagination.
